newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB not interested in ScotAm bid.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB not interested in ScotAm bid.

text.p: Lloyds TSB Group Plc is not interested in bidding for mutually-owned insurer Scottish Amicable, its chief executive Peter Ellwood said on Tuesday.
"We always run our slide-rule over any company that's possibly coming up for sale," Ellwood told Reuters in an interview, "but we certainly won't be progressing with any acquisition of that."
Ellwood noted that the price to be paid for ScotAm had already risen considerably since Abbey National first announced it was making a bid only to be trumped by insurance company Prudential.
"It looks like a big premium to me," Ellwood said.
ScotAm, which had intended to de-mutualise and seek a stock market flotation in three to five years' time, has now asked for formal offers from all interested parties.
